acceptance.given: Package A is designed or implemented under the frozen SM-REPAIR-CONSTRAINTS scope and authority boundaries.

oracle.expected: A static scope-boundary artifact check reports that Package A contains none of the explicitly excluded capabilities, systems, analyses, installation behaviors, or mandatory internal review requirements.
oracle.observable: The declared Package A production deliverables, tests, and write boundaries contain no forbidden additions or prohibited Phase/runtime/toolchain changes.

acceptance.then: The scope-boundary check emits a passing artifact with no excluded addition detected.
acceptance.when: During static Package A validation, inspect the declared deliverables, tests, production owners, and write boundaries and evaluate the emitted scope-check artifact.

failure_intents.selector_intent: The scope-boundary test rejects a Package A fixture or declaration containing any explicitly excluded capability, system, analysis, installation behavior, or mandatory internal review requirement.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Add a repository-owned static scope-boundary check that detects and rejects Package A additions from the explicit negative scope list.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Removing the scope-boundary check requires no persisted-state or schema migration; it only removes the added static validation behavior.

slice_hint.state_transition: Package A moves from unchecked negative scope to an explicit validation result that records whether excluded additions are present.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The repository-owned migration/scope test command passes for an in-scope package and fails for a fixture containing a forbidden addition.
